seo_title: Tariffs, Ansem and Jensen's Return with that1618guy
meta_description: Ansem's coin, the new chillwithr2.com, Netflix's FTX drama and Jensen's return, then that1618guy on an AI bailout, tariffs and Bitcoin's weekly chart.
summary: The hosts open on Ansem's coin and the hack claim around it, then make the big reveal: the new chillwithr2.com, with every episode, guest and community link in one place, and full episodes on YouTube and Spotify. They debate Netflix's FTX drama and CZ's reaction, then Jensen's return to Nvidia and new China tariffs. In his Tuesday segment, that1618guy asks whether the White House move is the start of an AI bailout, walks through his Nvidia trade and Bitcoin's weekly chart, and gives his take on the FTX series as someone hit by the collapse.
takeaways: The hosts argue that a coin carrying a creator's name tends to end only one way, set Ansem's coin next to two other recent creator coins that also blamed hacks, and say that "I got hacked" should not end the question of responsibility when other people's money is involved.

The big reveal is the new chillwithr2.com: an episode library with embedded replays, summaries, chapters and guest links, a community page and a guest wall, plus full episodes on YouTube and Spotify. The hosts call it CR2's first real step beyond X, with the YouTube livestream test pushed back while the setup is finished.

On Netflix's FTX series, the hosts say it is a drama, not a documentary, and that the real question is whether CZ already knew how deep FTX's hole was when he tweeted that Binance would buy it. that1618guy thinks he knew it was bad, and that the show is biased in how it portrays him.

On Jensen's return, the hosts say Nvidia's jump and crypto's quick fade show how much algos drive these moves, and that crypto now shares less of the gains and more of the pain. that1618guy asks whether the White House move is a one-off or the start of an AI bailout, and reads the new China tariffs as posturing he does not expect to go through.

that1618guy sees Bitcoin in a bottoming phase after seven red weekly candles, with no change of trend yet, so he would buy patiently instead of going all in. He does not expect big moves before next year, and says the Fed's language around its next decision now matters more than the decision itself.
